applyTo: "src/test/java/**/*.java"
description: "Map of the implemented tests and the files to open before changing or adding tests"

# Testing

Before searching the testing tree, read the project layer guidance for this repository.
Open only the files tied to the behavior area you are changing.

Use JUnit 5. Prefer tests that mirror the package of the class under test and name them `<ClassName>Test.java`.
